name: GoatCounter
description: Simple, privacy-friendly web analytics without cookies

paths.name: Goatcounter Data
paths.description: GoatCounter's SQLite database with your sites and all visits. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: GoatCounter dashboard and counter, published on host as 6891

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: GOATCOUNTER_LISTEN
variables.description: Where GoatCounter listens inside the container. Leave it as it is.

variables.name: GOATCOUNTER_TLS
variables.description: http serves plain http. Leave it; put a reverse proxy with https in front when your websites are public.

variables.name: GOATCOUNTER_PUBLIC_PORT
variables.description: The port people reach GoatCounter on, used in links and the tracking code. Set 443 behind a reverse proxy with https.
